item.title: New EKG requirements coming for Leon County high school athletes to detect heart conditions
item.description: After a vote from the county school board, first-time high school athletes will have to take one-time EKGs starting in the 2026-2027 school year to detect heart conditions early and improve safety.

item.title: Community steps up as prolonged cold threatens Lowndes County's most vulnerable
item.description: Local shelters and volunteers are expanding services as neighbors huddle together to get through an unusually long cold snap.

item.title: New program brings free internet and devices to children of incarcerated parents
item.description: For some families in Gadsden County, getting students online for school remains a challenge. A new program is stepping in to close the digital divide.
